'''Natanzi''' is one of the [[Central Iranian languages|Central Iranian]] varieties of [[Iran]], one of five listed in ''Ethnologue'' that together have 35,000 speakers. Dialects are Natanzi, Farizandi, Yarandi/Yarani. It is closely related to [[Soi language|Soi]].
